summary: Re-tested the 'every call ends with one exact quote' work: R1-R5, the 15:34 replay, wants_price/done-words/skipped/question budget, the Vapi webhook and portal agent/end backstop with one quote_ready message, the empty-scope package, PDFs, and the UI (Quotes page, QuoteDetail, LeadDrawer, portal quote, live estimate card in chat mode). Most of it works. Three bugs remain: (1) a free-text answer to a numeric fact gets the same question again (the 15:34 symptom), (2) invalid categorical answers are stored as-is and underprice items, (3) the portal and dashboard APIs still return low/high/range_pct. Full backend suite run serially (-n 0): 180 passed, 6 failed, 30 skipped. The 6 failures are obsolete tests or environment assumptions, not regressions from this change.

critical.issue: Each fact is supposed to be asked only once, but a free-text answer to a numeric fact breaks this. 'Retile the shower walls' asks shower_wall_area. If the answer is {'shower_wall_area':'pretty big I guess'} (or 'standard', 'big'), the exact same question comes back on the next turn, up to 3 times, and each repeat uses up the 5-question budget. RCA: engine.apply_answers ~line 401-403: when measure() returns None it does `continue` and leaves the fact 'asked'. The unanswered->assume step in run turn (line 765) skips it because the name IS in answers. Fix: `if num is None: self.assume(f); continue`.

R4 is only partly fixed. It no longer returns 500, but categorical answers are still not checked against the options. Itemizer.normalize() falls through to `return t`, so the raw text is stored as the value. Example: new_vanity_sinks='purple maybe' and new_vanity_mount='whatever you think' price the New vanity at $450, versus $2,900 with defaults. floor_new='banana' prices the Bathroom floor at $120 instead of $660. The bad value is silently priced, and these facts don't show in assumptions. Fix: if normalize finds no synonym or option, return None, and apply_answers should then assume the default.

minor.issue: The user asked for no low/high/range anywhere, but the payloads still include low/high/range_pct. Itemizer quotes have low=high=total. Legacy save_quote/persist/default_quote still compute total*0.9/1.1, and vapi summary() (the legacy_adjust path) returns those ranges to Alex.

The prompt notes for Alex still say 'give the `low` to `high` range' when pricing. If the live Vapi assistant prompt was built from this doc, Alex may still say a range. Update the doc and the Vapi dashboard prompt to say one exact total.

Design risk: when a turn has answers, everything in 'said' is ignored as new work. So 'standard, and also add a new toilet' sent with answers drops the toilet without telling anyone. This matches the spec, but Alex's prompt should send new work as a separate said-only turn.
'how much' and 'quote' match anywhere, so 'not sure how much space there is' or 'I got a quote from another guy' ends questioning and prices right away.
If a quote above $0 was saved earlier in the call, the backstop reuses it even when more scope was added after that price. The WhatsApp message then sends the older total.

issues: Wording is redundant: 'Assumed finish level: standard (assumed, to confirm at the site visit)' says 'assumed' twice. It is not the old doubled suffix, but it reads awkwardly.

passed_checks: R1: 'Hi, good afternoon' -> needs_info 'What work would you like done?', no package
Empty scope + wants_price -> 'Bathroom remodel, standard finish, medium size (assumed)' > $0
R2: package removed once a toilet is added; and once a custom koi-wall line is priced from the dashboard

R3: LED mirror -> Lighted (LED) mirror + Hardwired line + Permit (electrical), no exhaust fan; shower wall retile -> no Walk-in shower; descriptive clauses -> no custom line; niche -> Shower niche; wallpaper -> Accent wallpaper
R4: free text or numbers on every KB fact -> 200 on /turn and on update_scope via the portal agent/tools
R5: not sure / Not sure. / I'm not sure / no idea / I don't know -> assumed, never asked again; no doubled site-visit suffix
wants_price=true from a fresh state, a pending question, camera_on, or custom-only scope -> always ok > $0
Done-words (that's it, nothing else, just give me the quote, let's conclude, wrap up, Let's wrap this up.) -> price
Skipped facts never asked again; at most 5 questions, then price
Answers are not work: 'No size change' / 'no' / 'nothing else' create no lines and no to_be_priced
Vapi webhook end-of-call-report (2x and 3x) and portal agent/end (2x) -> one quote above $0 and exactly one quote_ready WhatsApp with the exact $ total
if_not gives an exact difference ('If it turns out to be load-bearing, the price goes up by $6,800.')
Dashboard PDF and portal PDF: exact total, no 'range' text
UI: Quotes page, QuoteDetail, LeadDrawer, portal quote card and live estimate card (chat mode) show one exact total, no '$X to $X'; PDF download works
Chat (mock) flow: add work -> 'not sure' -> priced $7,060 -> chat auto-ended -> one quote_ready message
